name: comp-53
blurb: Read-only input with a copy-to-clipboard button.
description: A read-only text field with a copy button that writes to clipboard and shows a check icon for 1.5 seconds. Includes a tooltip and button disable on copy.
use_when: Commands, codes, or content that users will copy (npm install, API keys, config snippets).
avoid_when: The content needs to be editable or you want a different copy feedback.
a11y: Label linked to input. Button has aria-label (dynamic). Icons marked aria-hidden. Tooltip shows on hover. Button disabled state after copy.
